# OpenSheetMusicDisplay trial vendor

OpenSheetMusicDisplay **2.1.2**, BSD-3-Clause (see LICENSE and AUTHORS).
Upstream: https://github.com/opensheetmusicdisplay/opensheetmusicdisplay

Unmodified browser bundle from:
https://registry.npmjs.org/opensheetmusicdisplay/-/opensheetmusicdisplay-2.1.2.tgz

Bundle SHA-256: `888b744196665ab10dba7ee311784deea9e1c545cf60b6089d455afec6b50a3f`

The npm package omits the LICENSE.txt referenced by its bundle. The accompanying
`opensheetmusicdisplay.min.js.LICENSE.txt` collects dependency license texts and
copyright/license comments from the official 2.1.2 release source map:
https://github.com/opensheetmusicdisplay/opensheetmusicdisplay/releases/download/2.1.2/opensheetmusicdisplay.min.js.map

Bundled dependencies include VexFlow, JSZip (MIT option), loglevel and
typescript-collections, with their dependencies. Their notices retain their own
licenses. The trial loads this local JS bundle, with no LilyPond WASM/runtime.

Trial URL: `../../osmd.html`. No runtime/example release packaging changes.
